title: High-Precision Dev Coverage
description: Coverage record for high-precision-dev workflow, embedded in the implementer/verifier artifact. Covers SPEC requirements, implementation surfaces, attack classes, and test evidence. All surfaces must be explicitly categorized — missing entries are detectable by the validator.

tested.description: SPEC requirements that were covered by tests or verification steps.

testCase.description: Test file path and/or test name (e.g. 'tests/auth.test.ts#login-valid').

evidence.description: Optional: concrete evidence — test output, assertion, or observation confirming coverage.

untested.description: SPEC requirements that could not be tested in this run. Must include an explicit reason. These are NOT assumed to be passing.

reason.description: Concrete reason why this requirement was not tested (e.g. 'requires mock clock not yet implemented').

outOfScope.description: SPEC requirements explicitly excluded from this implementation surface. Must include an explicit rationale.

reason.description: Rationale for exclusion (e.g. 'external dependency not available in test environment').

attackClassCoverage.description: Optional: adversary/disproof coverage of attack classes from references/ATTACK-CLASSES.md. Each entry records which attack class was tried and the outcome.

priorRunRef.description: Optional: reference to a prior run's artifact for traceability. Prior run data MUST NOT suppress new findings — it changes focus only.

artifactPath.description: Local path to the prior run artifact (e.g. 'IMPL_A_REPORT-2026-06-30.md').

suppressesFindings.description: MUST be false. Prior run data never suppresses critic/adversary findings in the current run.

contextNote.description: Brief note on how the prior run is relevant (e.g. 'prior run covered REQ-001 to REQ-003; this run adds REQ-004').

verificationStatus.description: Overall verification status. PARTIAL or SKIPPED requires at least one entry in 'untested' or 'outOfScope'.
